textbookBox.concept: When he crossed a pure tall plant with a pure short plant, all F1 plants were tall. In F2 tall and short appeared in the ratio 3 : 1.

beats.en: When he crossed a pure tall plant with a pure short plant, all F1 plants were tall. In F2 tall and short appeared in the ratio 3 : 1.
beats.speakEn: When he crossed a pure tall plant with a pure short plant, all F1 plants were tall. In F2 tall and short appeared in the ratio 3 : 1.

beats.en: So the tall trait is dominant and the short trait is recessive. Each trait is controlled by a pair of factors, now called genes.
